keys.label: Cleanup period days
keys.help: Set how many days Claude Code keeps session transcripts and other application data before deleting them. Claude Code runs the deletion as a background sweep after a session starts, as long as it can safely determine the retention period. The sweep deletes transcripts without showing a message, so a session you haven't used for longer than the retention period no longer appears in the `/resume` picker.
